calendarNotes: North East ISD starts the 2026-2027 school year on August 17, 2026 and ends on May 27, 2027. The instructional calendar lists 175 school days, with grading periods from August 17-October 8, October 13-December 18, January 5-March 5, and March 15-May 27. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, Winter Break runs December 21-January 1, and Spring Break runs March 8-12. The calendar also lists early dismissal dates by school level, teacher choice days on November 23-24, and severe weather make-up days on February 15 and April 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When does North East ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Monday, August 17, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is North East ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 8 through Friday, March 12, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for North East ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days are in the North East ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The North East ISD 2026-2027 instructional calendar lists 175 total school days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does North East ISD have early release days in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar lists early dismissal dates for elementary campuses, traditional campuses, and high schools. Families should confirm exact release times with their campus.

calendarFaqs.q: When does North East ISD Winter Break end?
calendarFaqs.a: North East ISD Winter Break ends on Friday, January 1, 2027. Students return after the January 4 student holiday and staff development day.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the North East ISD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the North East ISD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

calendarFaqs.q: Are North East ISD severe weather make-up days confirmed holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Severe weather make-up days are conditional planning dates and may be used if North East ISD needs to recover instructional time.

customSections.label: North East ISD Calendar Overview 2026-2027
customSections.content:
The North East ISD 2026-2027 instructional calendar provides districtwide student dates for school-year planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, student and staff holidays, student holidays and staff development days, early dismissal dates by school level, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, severe weather make-up days, grading periods, school start and end times, and the last day of school.

This page summarizes the official instructional calendar into key dates, downloadable calendar files, and a printable PDF source. Families should still verify campus-specific events, district testing windows, ACE calendar dates, Castle Hills Elementary calendar dates, athletics, graduation details, and emergency updates through North East ISD.

customSections.label: North East ISD Early Dismissal Dates 2026-2027
customSections.content: The official calendar marks early dismissal dates by campus level. Families should confirm exact dismissal procedures with their campus because early start elementary, later start elementary, middle school, and high school schedules use different dismissal times.

customSections.label: North East ISD Calendar Download FAQ
customSections.content: Use the printable PDF when you need the official district calendar format. Use the ICS file when you want to import North East ISD dates into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, or another personal calendar app. Calendar imports are one-time downloads, not live district syncs, so families should recheck the official North East ISD calendar before making important plans.

customSections.label: Family Planning Guide for North East ISD 2026-2027
customSections.content: North East ISD families often use the instructional calendar to coordinate childcare, travel, work schedules, and school transitions. The official calendar is especially important because early dismissal dates vary by campus level and severe weather make-up days are conditional. In northeast San Antonio and Bexar County, families should also watch program-specific calendars because ACE and Castle Hills Elementary may not follow every traditional-calendar date.

groups.label: Childcare planning
items: Plan coverage for early dismissal dates because elementary, traditional-campus, and high school dates do not all match.
Treat February 15 and April 23 as conditional severe weather make-up dates until North East ISD confirms whether they will be used.
Check January 4, 2027 because it is listed as a student holiday and staff development day after Winter Break.

groups.label: Travel planning
items: Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, 2026 and is the clearest full-week fall travel window.
Winter Break runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027, with students returning after the January 4 student holiday.
Spring Break runs March 8-12, 2027 and is the main spring travel window for districtwide student planning.

groups.label: School transition planning
items: Use August 17, 2026 to prepare transportation routines, supplies, and before-school or after-school care.
Review grading period end dates before scheduling appointments near October 8, December 18, March 5, and May 27.
Families in ACE or Castle Hills Elementary programs should check the separate alternate calendar before relying on traditional calendar dates.

customSections.label: How We Verify North East ISD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official North East ISD calendars page and published instructional calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last day, grading periods, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, student holidays, staff development days, early dismissal dates, severe weather make-up days, and alternate-calendar links, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official North East ISD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, testing windows, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.

customSections.label: North East ISD Calendar Update Policy
customSections.content: School calendars can change after publication because of district revisions, severe weather, emergency closures, or campus-specific announcements. MySchoolDates reviews official North East ISD calendar sources when a new school year is released, when the district publishes revised calendar information, and when date changes affect downloadable calendar files. For urgent schedule decisions, families should confirm directly with North East ISD or their campus.
